title: Canonical derived and higher-image transitions for module sheaves
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring and a:Y'→Y, h:Y→X, h':Y'→X be morphisms of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with a≫h=h'. For a bounded-below derived module sheaf K [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], define Rh_*K→Rh'_*a^*K by the unit for h', inverse-image composition, and a^* of the counit for h [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. For a module sheaf F and q∈ℤ define its higher-image transition by degree-q homology at F[0], followed by a^*F[0]≅(a^*F)[0]. For k:W→S, G on W, and φ:U→V in Over W, define the transition from the higher image of V^*G to that of U^*G by this map followed by φ^*V^*G≅U^*G. All sites are the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. These are the three source definitions, relocated verbatim with their full names and types unchanged.
